note: Official names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written in our own words; every fact cites its source. Four trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch — those guides say so honestly instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC — the whole list is single-player and offline. PowerPyx rates the run 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it on the 100% completion checklist. The only real rule for the whole run: never use cheats (they switch off trophies and saving) and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.
steps: Play the story through all five chapters (60–80 hours).
Work the 100% Completion Checklist after the credits (~100 hours).
Clean up the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the miscellaneous trophies (~10 hours).
Keep cheats off for the entire run.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the story.
steps: Finish the main mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops once Chapter 1 is done — PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that can be missed in the whole game: the balcony meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).
steps: In Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house (missable — see Positive Mental Attitude).
Finish Chapter 1 and start Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where you first get to switch between Jason and Lucia after the mission Coffee Break — from then on, several trophies open up that need both characters together.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 and start Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where most of the side systems open up — the Key Cloner, jewelry robberies, Randy's car wishlist — so take the optional missions as they appear; the quest givers stay available after the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 and play the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Before you start that mission, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, and a save at the end of each chapter is the safety net PowerPyx recommends for the whole run.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission of Chapter 4.
Complete the mission Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story. PowerPyx lists it as unlocking after the final main mission, Starting From Zero, in Chapter 4. Once the credits roll you drop back into free-roam and the 100% Completion Checklist opens under Progress, Stats — everything left is doable from there.
steps: Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. No extra step — just play the mission through.
steps: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions pay well too, which helps with the money trophies later (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes).
steps: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Chapter 4 is the densest part of the story for trophies: three more mission trophies (DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked) and the big bank jobs all sit here.
steps: Complete the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Just play the mission through.
steps: Complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Just play the mission through.
steps: Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory — the last chapter trophy before the finale. Just play the mission through.
steps: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the reason the platinum takes about 200 hours. After the story, open Touchpad, Progress, Stats, 100% Completion Checklist to see everything that counts. PowerPyx's figures: the bar sits around 60% when the story ends, and the big buckets are 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and 15 of 18 meditation spots — plus every optional mission, robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range and drone race. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and progress made during the story counts, so play the side content as it appears and clean up afterwards.
steps: Finish the story, then open Touchpad, Progress, Stats, 100% Completion Checklist.
Work the checklist top to bottom — vehicles, animals, weapons, challenges, stunts, meditations.
Finish all 100 optional missions, robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges and drone races.
The trophy pops at 100% — check the bar after each session.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the four kinds of set-piece driving trick, and the game has 397 of them in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You only need 250, so you can skip the hardest ones: under-bridge passes are the quickest to rack up, and a map with all stunt locations is linked in the PowerPyx guide. Track your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, Stunts. Note that 100% completion wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
steps: Open the PowerPyx stunt map and pick a cluster of under-bridge passes near Vice City.
Drive the route with a fast, stable car; a pass counts when the icon flashes.
Mix in stunt jumps and knife flights as you pass them.
Check Touchpad, Progress, Activities, Stunts — 250 pops the trophy, 300 for 100%.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine different activity types, one try each. PowerPyx lists them as: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Your count sits under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of these come naturally while chasing other trophies — fishing unlocks with Cal's questline, shooting ranges feed The Shootist, and a single stunt jump already counts toward Cunning Stunts.
steps: Fish once (Cal's questline after Chapter 1's Feng Shui).
Play one round of golf, one game of pool and one game of basketball.
Shoot one shooting range, play one arcade video game, win one race and do one stunt.
Check Touchpad, Progress, Activities — the trophy pops at 9 of 9.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Twelve shooting ranges in total, 42 gold medals to earn across them. PowerPyx has a full guide for the ranges — the link is in the sources — with the scoring for each one. This is a skill trophy: take a weapon you are accurate with, learn the range layout, and go for gold one range at a time. The ranges also count toward Master of None and the 100% checklist, and they raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn its target pattern on a practice run.
Earn gold at one range, then move to the next — 12 ranges, 42 golds total.
Use a weapon with a steady sight picture; take your time between shots.
The trophy pops at the 42nd gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Drone racing has 14 locations and 42 races — win them all. PowerPyx links a full drone-race guide from this trophy's page. Each race is a timed course through gates; learn the line, cut corners where the gates allow, and restart the ones you lose instead of finishing slowly. All 42 wins also count toward the 100% checklist.
steps: Find a drone race location and win your first race.
Work through all 14 locations, 3 races each — 42 wins total.
Restart a lost race immediately instead of finishing it.
The trophy pops on the 42nd win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: There are 40 unique race locations in total — you need wins at 20 different ones. The trick is variety, not repetition: the same location won twice only counts once, so keep moving to new spots. Race locations are scattered across Leonida; take the faster car classes for the highway circuits and something grippy for the tight city courses. This pairs naturally with the driving you do for Cunning Stunts.
steps: Win a race at one location, then move to a new one — repeats do not count.
Pick cars to suit the course: fast for highways, grippy for city streets.
Track the count of unique locations won at.
The trophy pops at 20 unique locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fishing opens after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal). After that, Cal texts you and a purple fishing icon appears on the map. Follow his questline to the end — it builds to a fishing challenge against Cal himself, and the trophy's own wording is 'Beat Cal in a fishing challenge'. Fishing also counts as one of the nine activities for Master of None, and the quests are a calm break from the story, so do them as they arrive rather than saving them for the end.
steps: After the mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), wait for Cal's text.
Follow the purple fishing icon and complete each quest he sends.
Finish the whole questline — beat Cal in the final fishing challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four arcade games count: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (all playable on the home TV) and Bang For Your Buck (arcade machines). You only need to finish every level of one game, once. Pick the game you find easiest — Tenebrae Lux is the usual pick — and play through its levels. You do not need to beat any bonus challenges or high scores.
steps: Go to a TV at home or an arcade machine.
Pick one game — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Finish every level of that one game. The trophy pops on the final level.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline opens in Chapter 3 as Lucia. When a call comes in from Andy, a green A appears on the map at the Belville parking garage. There are five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. They are short fetch-and-delivery jobs around Vice City. This is one of the questlines you can do after the story too, so there is no rush — but do not confuse Andy's quests with the Strangers & Freaks strands; they are separate.
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call and go to the green A at the Belville parking garage.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain (1–3), then Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops after the fifth quest.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He shows up on the map at Key Lento and asks you to dive seven shipwrecks and bring back their treasure. You scan the seabed with a metal detector, then dive to each wreck — PowerPyx has a full guide with all seven locations. Your progress is tracked under Touchpad, Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees and under Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Kenton is unavailable for a stretch after Chapter 1, but he returns in Chapters 2–3, so the quests are not missable.
steps: After the mission Island Dreams in Chapter 1, meet Kenton at Key Lento.
Dive the seven shipwrecks and recover the treasure from each.
Track progress at Touchpad, Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. The trophy pops after the seventh.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — the same point where character switching unlocks. Head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and run his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. They are loud, messy mud-club jobs and do not take long. Like Andy's and Kenton's, this questline stays available after the story.
steps: After the mission Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops after the fifth quest.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the trickiest quest trophy to plan, because not every side character counts. PowerPyx's finding so far: the strands that count include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, plus more that were still undiscovered at the time of writing — while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward it. There are no missable strands; all of them stay available after the story. The honest advice is to do every side quest you find, check the PowerPyx quest page for the latest confirmed list before you start the cleanup phase, and let the count catch up naturally. Your progress is tracked under Touchpad, Progress, Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play every side quest that appears — look for the ? icons on the map.
Complete the confirmed strands first: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Check the PowerPyx quest page for the latest confirmed list before your cleanup phase.
The trophy pops on the eighth qualifying strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, once you have the Key Cloner. A green RK icon appears on the map west of Vice City — go there and meet Randy. He wants 16 sports cars from his wishlist; you scan cars with the WAiNK camera (hold up, R1), steal the ones on his list, and deliver them to him. Deliver them in good condition for extra pay, and use a tracker-blocking method if you have one. The Key Cloner is the same tool you need for Capital Offense, so the two trophies pair up.
steps: After the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, meet Randy at the green RK icon west of Vice City.
Scan cars with WAiNK and steal the 16 wishlist sports cars.
Deliver each one in good condition. The trophy pops on the sixteenth.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline opens in Chapter 3 as Jason, after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Synthetic Labs sites appear as purple markers — destroy them to work through the questline, which ends with the quest Spin On This. It is a short chain of sabotage jobs; a sturdy vehicle and a decent weapon make it quick. Like the other questlines, it stays available after the story.
steps: In Chapter 3 as Jason, finish the mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs sites marked in purple.
Complete the final quest, Spin On This. The trophy pops.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy in the whole set that can be missed, so read this before you start Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, tracked under Touchpad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. You only need 15 of them for 100% completion, but the trophy itself wants all 18 — including the first spot, which is missable. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is in the kitchen in the morning and says she will go meditate; follow her to the balcony, press and hold Triangle and choose Accept. That spot is gone if you leave Chapter 1 without it. Most other spots let you meditate with either character, but the final one needs BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same spot, which is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks switching. A map of all 18 spots is linked in the PowerPyx guide.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony in the morning and Accept the meditation — DO NOT skip this.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), character switching opens — the final spot needs both characters together.
Visit the remaining spots; track them at Touchpad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
The trophy pops at 18 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's questline opens as Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts you about meeting in Lummox County. His chain is Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) and a series of hunting quests. You need a hunting rifle — PowerPyx names the Killtelligence SM-69 — and you work through 15 Target Decks, which are hunting contracts naming a specific animal. PowerPyx noted the exact animal for each deck was still unconfirmed at the time of writing, so check the guide page for the latest list before you start hunting; the decks are the slow part of this trophy.
steps: After the mission Coffee Break, take Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Get the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle.
Complete the 15 Target Decks — check the PowerPyx page for the latest animal list.
The trophy pops after the final deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three collectible card sets, 18 set locations in total — PowerPyx has a full map with every location. Cards are tucked into interiors, rooftops and odd corners across Leonida, so a map is essential; wandering will take far longer than following the guide. Each set is a self-contained collection, so finish one set before moving to the next and the progress is easy to track.
steps: Open the PowerPyx card map and pick one set to finish first.
Collect every card in that set, then move to the next.
The trophy pops when all three sets are complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game phone camera. Hold up on the d-pad and press R1 to scan an object, and the game logs it. You need 100 scans; the counts break down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags — and there are more than 100 scannable objects in the world, so you do not need every single one. This pairs perfectly with Whip It Good (scan 557 vehicles the same way) and with Randy's car wishlist, so scan everything you pass instead of making a dedicated trip.
steps: Hold up on the d-pad and press R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Scan as you travel — 100 total is the goal; there are more than 100 available.
Combine this with vehicle scanning for Whip It Good.
The trophy pops at 100 scans.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the small feats listed under Touchpad, Progress, Challenges — there are 80 in total, and you need 50 of them. Most come from ordinary play: driving, shooting, flying, swimming, stunts. You only need to finish half, so skip the ones you hate and bank the easy ones first. Note that 100% completion wants 70 challenges, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Challenges and sort by the ones you are closest to.
Clear the easy challenges first — driving, shooting and stunts.
The trophy pops at 50. Keep going to 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, a 4-star wanted level, and a clean escape. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner with hold right on the d-pad plus Triangle. Then get the heat up to 4 stars and lose it: escape the search area, then escape the wider heat zone — the second step is the part people miss. PowerPyx's tip is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia: it breaks line of sight and the wanted level drops fast. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… if you escape the police there with your partner.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold right on the d-pad + Triangle).
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the search area, then escape the heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia helps.
The trophy pops when the wanted level clears with your partner nearby.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, you can rob shops with your partner — three of them back-to-back, without losing the wanted level in between. Your partner handles the cashier while you watch the door. PowerPyx's advice: wait until Chapter 3, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, and rob the jewelry stores north of Vice City — they are close together and pay well. Use the whole playbook for a wanted level: an armored vest, sticky bombs for the getaway, Zombix and Adrenaline if it gets hairy, and a fast car parked facing the road. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop.
steps: After Coffee Break, bring your partner and an armored vest.
Rob one shop, then a second, then a third — without losing the wanted level between them.
Jewelry stores north of Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are the easiest trio.
The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Same WAiNK camera as You WAiNKer! — hold up on the d-pad and press R1 on a vehicle to log it. The trophy's own wording is 'Discover 100 vehicles', and there are 557 vehicles in the world to find — sit at a busy junction in Vice City and scan everything that passes. 100% completion only needs 200 base models, so the trophy's 100 is the easier target. Track the count under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
steps: Hold up on the d-pad and press R1 to scan a vehicle.
Sit at a busy Vice City junction and scan passing traffic.
Work the count up to 100 — track it at Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim mode: hold L3 and R3 together while aiming. You need to take down five enemies during one use of it. The trick is preparation — eat and drink before the fight, wash your face or take a shower to keep your Focus high, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the slow-motion window. PowerPyx recommends the Duke 556 assault rifle for the job. It does not work on soldiers, police officers or civilians, so pick a gang fight. Your Focus level rises by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and level 4 is the strongest version.
steps: Raise your Focus level (ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) and stock Adrenaline.
Find a gang fight and eat/drink before you engage.
Aim, hold L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus, and drop five enemies in one use.
The trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The big planes are docked at the departure terminal. PowerPyx marks gates E3 and E4 as the easiest way in — go upstairs to the terminal, walk to the docked plane, and climb into the cockpit. Reverse it out to the airstrip, then take off and fly at least 1 km away. The trophy is a little delayed after takeoff, so keep flying until it pops. Bring a fast car to the airport so you can get in and out quickly.
steps: Go to the departure terminal — gates E3 and E4 are the easiest entry.
Board a docked large passenger plane and take the cockpit.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away.
Keep flying until the trophy pops — it is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Tanks are parked at the Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island in Mariana County, south of the air base. The base is guarded, so expect a fight: either drive through the gate in something fast and tough, or use a stunt jump by the southeast entrance to get over the wall. Once you are in the tank, shoot at enemies until the trophy pops — it triggers on the theft and the destruction, so do not bail out early.
steps: Go to the Mile Zero Air Station, southwest island, Mariana County.
Get in through the gate or over the wall by the southeast entrance.
Take a tank and shoot at enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you can get the Snap Gun, and that is the tool for this trophy. Go in through the back door — do not kick it down, or you trip the alarm. Inside, find the safe code written on a note, open the safe, and get out quietly. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds as the easiest store for a clean silent run. If the alarm goes off, leave and try again; a silent robbery needs no police attention at all.
steps: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door — never kick it down.
Find the safe code on a note, open the safe, and leave silently. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the easiest.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Large bank jobs open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… The method: tail a security van, then rob the bank vault — bring your partner so they can carry a bag of cash. There are eight large bank jobs in total; this trophy needs five of them, while 100% completion needs all eight. Yasmani tips you $10,000 after his Payday Loans quests, and a single bank can pay up to $205,000. Expect a 4-star wanted level on the way out — a motorcycle is the best getaway, and the same escape counts toward A Classic Blitz Play. PowerPyx has a full bank-robbery guide linked in the sources.
steps: After the mission That's Where The Money Is…, tail a security van to a large bank.
Rob the vault with your partner carrying a bag.
Escape the 4-star wanted level — a motorcycle is fastest.
Repeat at five different banks. All eight for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This is the escape half of Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy's own wording is an armored truck robbery and escape: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on the back door, take the cash, and lose the police. A large bank vault escape works too — rob the vault, then break line of sight, get out of the search area, then out of the heat zone. A Pay 'n' Spray helps if your car is the problem, and a motorcycle is the easiest vehicle to slip away on. The trophy pops when the wanted level clears after the robbery.
steps: Block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on the back door, and take the cash — or rob a large bank vault.
Break line of sight and escape the search area, then the heat zone.
Use a motorcycle or a Pay 'n' Spray to make the getaway stick.
The trophy pops when the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The whole map needs to be uncovered — no fog left anywhere. The fastest way is a plane: fly a grid over Leonida at medium altitude and watch the fog peel back. A car works too but takes far longer, and the small islands are easy to miss from the road. Do it once, early in the cleanup phase, and you will know every location for the other collectibles.
steps: Take a plane and fly a grid over the whole map at medium altitude.
Cover the small islands — they are the easiest to miss.
The trophy pops when the last patch of fog clears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations across Leonida, marked with yellow icons. You need to rob one operation per gang — nine robberies — while 100% completion wants all 39. Track the count under Touchpad, Progress, Gangs. Operations are guarded, so bring a decent weapon and a getaway car; the robbing itself is quick once you are inside. PowerPyx has a full guide to every operation and which gang runs it.
steps: Find a yellow gang-operation icon on the map.
Rob the operation — one per gang, nine gangs total.
Track progress at Touchpad, Progress, Gangs. All 39 for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The trophy's own description gives the method away: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to one of the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — the trophy pops when the drink is served. No grind, no quest chain: a small interaction in the right place. If it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot; the view is the point.
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
The trophy pops when the drink is served.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A blue Banshee sits in the showroom south of Vice City. You need the Key Cloner to take it without a tracker — the same tool from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs that Randy's questline uses. Walk in, clone the key, get in the Banshee, and drive it straight through the showroom window. The trophy pops after you drive away. It is a GTA III easter egg, and a fun one: the window smash is the whole point, so do not sneak it out quietly.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs).
Go to the showroom south of Vice City and clone the blue Banshee.
Drive it through the showroom window and away. The trophy pops.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is one of the nine gang operations — and this one has its own trophy. Inside you need three key valuables: a luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the northeast, and a safe in the northeast hallway that you open with sticky bombs. Grab all three, then escape the police — the trophy pops after the getaway. If you miss an item, the valuables respawn, so nothing here is missable; just run it again.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, as a gang operation.
Take the luxury watch (southeast office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (northeast table), and the safe (northeast hallway, sticky bombs).
Escape the police. The trophy pops after the getaway.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Both characters need maximum strength at the same time. Buy a fitness club membership, then work out with the character you are playing — when you switch, your partner trains automatically, so both bars climb together. Check the bars under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength. It is a slow grind if you do it in one sitting, so fold it into your normal play: work out whenever you pass a gym and let the partner training do the rest.
steps: Buy a fitness club membership.
Work out regularly — your partner trains automatically while you switch.
Check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength. The trophy pops when both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Your criminal profile grows with almost everything you do in the world — crimes, stunts, robberies, even small infractions. Turn on the notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so you can see what counts. The profile tiers are Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable, and they are permanent — so do not chase the worst tier for fun. 500 actions sounds like a lot, but it comes naturally across a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, a session of robberies and stunts will close the gap.
steps: Turn on Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile.
Play normally — crimes, stunts and robberies all count.
The trophy pops at 500 profile actions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: the unlock method was not confirmed at launch. PowerPyx's best lead is the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — try the storefront and any interaction it offers. This guide will not invent a method: check the PowerPyx trophy page for updates, and treat any method that appears there as the current best guess.
steps: Try the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — it is the current best lead.
Check the PowerPyx trophy page for updates; the method was unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Honest answer: the unlock method was not confirmed at launch. PowerPyx's best lead is the UFO questline — the strange lights and the quest chain that follows them. If you are playing through the side content anyway, take every UFO-related quest you find; the trophy is most likely tied to finishing that chain. Check the PowerPyx trophy page for updates before you go hunting for it specifically.
steps: Follow the UFO questline and take every related quest you find.
Check the PowerPyx trophy page for updates; the method was unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The trophy's own description confirms the mechanic: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. That means kicking enemies from a moving motorcycle — PowerPyx's best lead matches it. Get on a motorcycle, ride past an enemy, and kick as you pass. Do it to a few enemies in normal play and the trophy should pop quickly; it is a small interaction, not a grind.
steps: Get on a motorcycle and ride toward an enemy.
Kick as you pass — a melee drive-by.
Repeat on a few enemies; the trophy pops once it registers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank robberies and Payday Loans stores. After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) you get the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you spend them — take the marked cash to a fence, and Yasmani pays the most for it. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so a couple of large bank jobs plus a few Payday Loans runs will cover the $250,000 total. This pairs directly with Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play, so do it during the bank-robbery cleanup.
steps: After Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), get the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for marked bills.
Fence the bills — Yasmani pays the most. The trophy pops at $250,000 exchanged.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: One hundred thousand dollars across all shops — guns, car mods, tattoos, clothes, anything. The fastest spend is the expensive end of the catalogue: a good weapon with attachments at one of the 24 Ammu-Nations, or a full mod job at one of the 14 mod shops. PowerPyx counts the shop network at 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo, 15 electronics, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 24 Ammu-Nations, so you are never far from a till. This pops naturally if you buy the gear for the other trophies instead of saving your money.
steps: Spend at any shop — weapons and car mods are the fastest way to $100,000.
The trophy pops at $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight purchasable garages in total — four of them are story-related, and the rest you buy. The buying opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): use the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone and buy the garages as they appear. The total cost is about $160,000, so save up from the heist missions and bank jobs first. Garages are also what make On the Spot possible, so buy them before you start registering vehicles.
steps: After the mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy garages as they appear — 8 total, about $160,000 altogether.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), the Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles at Moses in Port Gellhorn — Respray plus Register. You need ten registered. The catch is trackers: at first you can only register vehicles without trackers, and only later, at a Pay 'n' Spray, can you fit a standard tracker. Buy your garages first (Little Boxes), then register cheap cars and bikes you do not mind keeping — the cost adds up if you pick expensive ones. This is the companion trophy to Little Boxes, so do them together.
steps: After the mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), open the Scooter Bros app.
Take cheap cars and bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn — Respray + Register.
Register 10 vehicles. The trophy pops on the tenth.
